app.name: Kilo Code Bot
app.description:
The one **[Kilo Code](https://kilo.ai/)** app that powers both automated code reviews and an in-thread AI teammate on GitHub. Catch bugs before merge, enforce standards, and mention @kilocode-bot for answers and fixes without leaving GitHub.

- Installs once, enables both automated reviews and the bot
- Instant automated code reviews on every PR
- Catch bugs before they reach production
- Enforce coding standards consistently
- Mention @kilocode-bot on issues, PRs, or review comments for context-aware answers
Tag it on an issue to diagnose the cause or ship a fix as a PR
Complement human code review

app.name: Gitar Bot
app.description:
Gitar reviews your pull requests and fixes the issues it finds. Every fix is validated against your CI pipeline before you see it.

Apply fixes with one click. Comment `Gitar fix` or `@gitar-bot fix` on any review to apply changes.

You must be logged into the Gitar web app before installing this app. Log in or Sign up at https://app.gitar.ai.
